title: Risk score record
description: Risk scores of one patient at the start of a systemic therapy line, computed from the baseline record. One record per patient, linked by patient_id. Risks are probabilities between 0 and 1.

patient_id.title: Patient ID
patient_id.description: Identifier of the patient, as in the baseline record.

model_version.title: Model version
model_version.description: Version of the model configuration that produced the scores.

severe_toxicity_90d_risk.title: Risk of severe toxicity in 90 days
severe_toxicity_90d_risk.description: Candidate 1: probability of at least one adverse event of CTCAE grade 3 to 5 within 90 days of therapy start.

severe_toxicity_90d_regimen_rate.title: Regimen rate of severe toxicity
severe_toxicity_90d_regimen_rate.description: Candidate 1: risk of the reference patient on the same regimen, as the model configuration defines that patient. Equals the published rate of the regimen.

severe_toxicity_90d_category.title: Risk category, severe toxicity
severe_toxicity_90d_category.description: Candidate 1: risk category from the thresholds in the model configuration.

ild_applicable.title: Lung toxicity model applies
ild_applicable.description: Candidate 2: true if the model has a lung toxicity rate for the regimen. If false, the other ild fields are null.

ild_risk.title: Risk of lung toxicity
ild_risk.description: Candidate 2: probability of drug-related interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis of any grade within the time window of the model.

ild_grade2plus_risk.title: Risk of lung toxicity, grade 2 or higher
ild_grade2plus_risk.description: Candidate 2: probability of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis of grade 2 or higher within the time window of the model.

ild_regimen_rate.title: Regimen rate of lung toxicity
ild_regimen_rate.description: Candidate 2: published rate of the regimen, i.e. the mean risk in the trial population.

ild_category.title: Risk category, lung toxicity
ild_category.description: Candidate 2: risk category from the thresholds in the model configuration.

neutropenia_applicable.title: Neutropenia model applies
neutropenia_applicable.description: Candidate 3: true for regimens with a published rate of severe neutropenia. If false, the other neutropenia fields are null.

neutropenia_risk.title: Risk of severe neutropenia
neutropenia_risk.description: Candidate 3: probability of severe neutropenia within the time window of the model.

neutropenia_regimen_rate.title: Regimen rate of severe neutropenia
neutropenia_regimen_rate.description: Candidate 3: published rate of the regimen, i.e. the mean risk in the reference population.

neutropenia_category.title: Risk category, severe neutropenia
neutropenia_category.description: Candidate 3: risk category from the thresholds in the model configuration.

diarrhoea_applicable.title: Diarrhoea model applies
diarrhoea_applicable.description: Candidate 4: true for regimens with a published rate of severe diarrhoea. If false, the other diarrhoea fields are null.

diarrhoea_risk.title: Risk of severe diarrhoea
diarrhoea_risk.description: Candidate 4: probability of severe diarrhoea within the time window of the model.

diarrhoea_regimen_rate.title: Regimen rate of severe diarrhoea
diarrhoea_regimen_rate.description: Candidate 4: published rate of the regimen, i.e. the mean risk in the reference population.

diarrhoea_category.title: Risk category, severe diarrhoea
diarrhoea_category.description: Candidate 4: risk category from the thresholds in the model configuration.

cv_applicable.title: Cardiovascular model applies
cv_applicable.description: Candidate 5: true for patients under androgen deprivation. If false, the other cv fields are null.

cv_risk.title: Risk of a cardiovascular event
cv_risk.description: Candidate 5: probability of a major adverse cardiovascular event within the time window of the model.

cv_reference_rate.title: Published rate of cardiovascular events
cv_reference_rate.description: Candidate 5: published rate for the type of androgen deprivation, i.e. the mean risk in the trial population.

cv_category.title: Risk category, cardiovascular events
cv_category.description: Candidate 5: risk category from the thresholds in the model configuration.
